definitions.gloss: sound of rain; patter of rain
definitions.explanation: The sound made by falling rain. A word with aesthetic and atmospheric associations, often used in literary and everyday contexts.

examples.japanese: {雨音|あまおと}が{聞|き}こえる。
examples.english: I can hear the sound of rain.

examples.japanese: {雨音|あまおと}を{聞|き}きながら{眠|ねむ}りについた。
examples.english: I fell asleep listening to the sound of the rain.

examples.japanese: {激|はげ}しい{雨音|あまおと}で{目|め}が{覚|さ}め、{窓|まど}の{外|そと}を{見|み}ると{道|みち}が{川|かわ}のようになっていた。
examples.english: I was woken by the loud sound of rain, and when I looked outside, the road had turned into a river.

notes:
READING:
The kanji {雨|あめ} takes the combining form あま- in compounds: {雨音|あまおと}, {雨水|あまみず}, {雨雲|あまぐも}. This あま- form is a common pattern in native Japanese compounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雨音|あまおと}が{聞|き}こえる (to hear the sound of rain)
- {雨音|あまおと}を{聞|き}く (to listen to the rain)
- {激|はげ}しい{雨音|あまおと} (heavy rain sound)
- {静|しず}かな{雨音|あまおと} (quiet patter of rain)

SIMILAR COMPOUNDS:
Other ～{音|おと} compounds: {足音|あしおと} (footsteps), {物音|ものおと} (noise/sound), {風音|かざおと} (sound of wind).
